# Mechanical shell click: scope and references

Owner136/835 physical use on2026-11-14 received4reliable hardware TAPs and4successful SendInput click submissions, with0clicked test targets. The gyro moved rapidly on samples following the TAP. Normal136 reset the old filter once but immediately accepted the next impact sample, even emitting click and new movement in the same native frame.

This platform fix keeps the relative click at the visible cursor (01b's fix for the old100ms teleport remains). After a confirmed hardware CLICK, discard150ms of card movement in sensor time, while continuing sequence/time/readiness and reliable controls. Do not accumulate/replay discarded movement. Ordinary mouse input remains usable and can reanchor the cursor. A second genuine TAP still emits its own click. Pause, reconnect or a real gap clears the settling state.

Design reference: [Gyro-Mouse-Controller, fixed5fe85f465efc59ad608591038d61efe421aa2b09](https://github.com/younes-makhchan/Gyro-Mouse-Controller/blob/5fe85f465efc59ad608591038d61efe421aa2b09/src/main.cpp) uses CLICK_FREEZE_MS=150 after button presses. We use that simple mechanical-click stabilization pattern, adapted to existing reliable LSM6DSO TAP events and the existing sensor clock. No external source code or dependency is imported; this is not that project's accelerometer or cursor algorithm, and not a new learned gesture classifier.

The pinned [WatchPointer504137a1](watch/Mac/Sources/WatchPointer/Receiver.swift) explains the physical tap jolt and uses touch-down timing for click origin. Companion currently has no touch-down sensor: do not claim the same precise pre-contact timing or restore the old unconditional100ms relative rewind. Pre-event jolt and missed light taps are NOT proven fixed by this post-event change. Keep actual Owner acceptance open.

Regression scope: actual136gyro rebound replay, CLICK/CIM same-frame interleaving, two clicks, normal-mouse takeover, gap/pause and the existing tilt/fine-motion cases. Replay demonstrates discarded rebound in the real production Pointer; it cannot prove physical click recall, intended target or usability. MCU code/frequency/buffers/FPU/DSP and recording double-tap recognition are unchanged.
